22.3 Acres of Pasture land with Views & Building Potential

This 22.3-acre property sits high on Beebe Hil Road overlooking farm fields hills with a south facing view.
Currently this property is used for pasture ground but offers an excellent opportunity for expanded agricultural use, future development, or a country home with ample road frontage of 1,243 feet. The land is well laid out for efficient farming while also offering flexibility for a variety of other uses.
With a convenient access and  field layout, this is a nice parcel for and multiple use possibilities.
